headline: Banquet and Catering Supervisor
summary: Banquet and catering supervisor with seven years in hotel and catering operations in Bataan. I lead a team of 20 servers and cooks at weddings, conferences and outside catering, coordinate events and bookings with clients, and make sure food is prepared and served safely and on time.

experience.title: Banquet and Catering Supervisor
bullets: Supervise 20 servers and cooks for weddings, conferences and outside catering of up to 600 guests.
Plan each event's menu, timing and staffing with the client and the kitchen.
Take event bookings and keep the banquet calendar.
Brief staff on food handling, service standards and guest needs before each event.
Handle guests' requests and complaints during events.

experience.title: Banquet Captain
bullets: Led a team of eight servers at banquets and buffets.
Set up function rooms and checked table settings before guests arrived.

education.credential: Diploma in Hotel and Restaurant Services

certifications.name: Food and Beverage Services NC II
